children: Gold futures are making a modest recovery as oil prices retreat and Treasury yields pull back from overnight highs. The rise in yields has been behind the slide in precious metals in recent days. "Both gold and silver have reached levels that, in the past, have acted as strongholds," Peter Cardillo of Spartan Capital says in a note. "Therefore, we believe these levels may prove to be attractive entry points." Gold for December delivery is up 0.7% in New York at $4,428.50 a troy ounce. Silver gains 0.8% to $65.91 a troy ounce. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
